drhp.business: The Company manufactures and sells intermediates for Pharmaceuticals, Agro-chemicals, Optical Brighteners, Dyes and Perfumery and Paint industries. Its unit Daurala Organics additionally carries out contract manufacturing for a leading MNC, making Statin Intermediates. Its main customers are API intermediates and agrochemical manufacturers, both in India and abroad.

risks.note: Management states intense competition from low-cost Chinese manufacturers continues to suppress realisations in several product segments. During 2025-26 it drove demand shrinkage in PG and derivatives and contract-manufacturing products, and prevented a sharp rise in raw material prices from being passed on in PHPG derivatives, compressing margins in the last two quarters.
risks.risk: Low-cost Chinese import competition suppressing realisations

risks.note: The Company flags high dependence on imported raw materials and feedstock for certain chemical products, exposing it to global supply chain disruptions and currency fluctuations; volatility in raw material prices and forex directly impacted margins, as experienced with PHPG derivatives during the year.
risks.risk: Raw material price volatility and dependence on imported feedstock

risks.note: The declared aim of the R&D programme and market studies is to derisk the portfolio by diversifying the product range, reducing segment concentration and developing intermediates less exposed to commodity pricing cycles and import substitution pressures - an explicit acknowledgement that the current mix is concentrated and commodity-exposed. Conventional PG derivatives are described as of declining relevance.
risks.risk: Product and segment concentration in commodity-priced intermediates

risks.note: Operations are energy-intensive, leaving results sensitive to changes in fuel, power and logistics costs.

Stringent EHS regulation requires continuous investment in compliance and sustainability measures, and changes in environmental laws, regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements are flagged as leading to increased operational costs.
risks.risk: Environmental, health and safety regulation and changing compliance requirements

risks.note: Flagged as affecting demand and exports and as necessitating more active short- and medium-term strategic planning; the global socio-economic environment is described as remaining in turmoil with trade fragmentation and sustained supply chain disruption, and near-term demand is expected to remain measured.
risks.risk: Geopolitical uncertainty, trade restrictions and global slowdown affecting exports

risks.note: Long gestation periods and high capital expenditure requirements are cited for R&D and for setting up and expanding manufacturing facilities, while several projects - the Cephalexin enzymatic-route intermediate, agro/pharma capacity expansions, de-bottlenecking and the wastewater recycling plant - remain in progress; the year's investments have already weighed on reported profitability in the short term.
risks.risk: Execution and gestation risk on expansion and R&D

risks.note: Flagged explicitly: the demerger-related company name change disrupted export registrations, with foreign buyers requiring time to re-register new vendor details, which disrupted export activity in the final quarter.
risks.risk: Regulatory and administrative complexity from the corporate restructuring
